options.label: A
options.action: Use neoadjuvant imatinib to downsize tumor, then proceed to surgical excision with goal of negative margins.

options.label: B
options.action: Proceed directly to surgical excision with goal of negative margins despite functional/cosmetic concerns, with multidisciplinary planning.

options.label: C
options.action: Margins clear after Mohs/PDEMA: no adjuvant radiation therapy; delay or perform reconstruction only after margin clearance and begin routine follow-up.

options.label: D
options.action: Perform re-resection using Mohs/PDEMA or combined techniques to achieve clear margins before reconstruction; avoid wide undermining until margins are clear.

options.label: E
options.action: Positive margins, further resection not feasible, prior RT given: manage with multidisciplinary consultation for other systemic or palliative options (e.g., imatinib) and surveillance.

options.label: F
options.action: Positive margins, further resection not feasible, no prior RT: give adjuvant radiation therapy (50–60 Gy for indeterminate/positive margins, up to 66 Gy for gross tumor) with wide fields.

options.label: G
options.action: Negative margins achieved with Mohs/PDEMA: no adjuvant radiation therapy; begin routine follow-up and consider delayed reconstruction after verification of clear margins.

options.label: H
options.action: Negative but close (<1 cm) margins without Mohs/PDEMA: consider adjuvant radiation therapy with fields extending 3–5 cm beyond surgical margins when feasible.

options.label: I
options.action: Negative and adequately wide (≥1 cm) margins without Mohs/PDEMA: no adjuvant treatment; delay extensive reconstruction until margin clearance and start routine follow-up.

options.label: J
options.action: Perform re-resection (preferably with meticulous margin control) aiming for negative margins; avoid wide undermining and delay tissue rearrangement until margins are clear.

options.label: K
options.action: Positive margins after WLE, further resection not feasible, prior RT given: manage with multidisciplinary consultation for other local/systemic options (e.g., imatinib) and close surveillance.

options.label: L
options.action: Positive margins after WLE, further resection not feasible, no prior RT: give adjuvant radiation therapy (50–60 Gy for indeterminate/positive margins, up to 66 Gy for gross tumor) with wide fields.

options.label: M
options.action: Resect recurrent tumor whenever possible, using techniques emphasizing complete margin assessment; consider adjuvant radiation therapy if margins are positive/indeterminate and further resection is not feasible.

options.label: N
options.action: Recurrent, unresectable tumor with prior RT: consider systemic imatinib mesylate or other palliative/systemic options; maintain close clinical follow-up.

options.label: O
options.action: Recurrent, unresectable tumor without prior RT: use definitive radiation therapy (50–60 Gy for indeterminate/positive margins, up to 66 Gy for gross tumor) as primary local treatment.

options.label: P
options.action: For unresectable disease after multiple resections or when further surgery would cause unacceptable functional/cosmetic outcomes: consider systemic imatinib mesylate; use RT if not given previously and surgery is not feasible.

options.label: Q
options.action: If not clearly unresectable and not recurrent after multiple resections, reassess resectability and manage per primary surgical pathway aiming for complete excision with clear margins.

options.label: R
options.action: Metastatic DFSP: perform multidisciplinary consultation; manage according to soft tissue sarcoma guidelines, with consideration of systemic imatinib and other multimodal therapies including CT imaging of draining nodal basin and chest.

options.label: S
options.action: Non-localized, non-metastatic pattern not clearly defined (e.g., regional spread only): obtain multidisciplinary consultation and follow soft tissue sarcoma guidelines for multimodal therapy and surveillance.

options.label: T
options.action: Insufficient explicit patient evidence to select a guideline recommendation.
